content_sections.heading: AIIMS Kalyani Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following essential qualification for AIIMS Kalyani Junior Resident (Non-Academic) Recruitment 2026: MBBS from an institution recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC). The candidate must have completed the compulsory internship and must produce the internship completion certificate and registration under any State Medical Council. Candidates who have passed MBBS (including internship) not earlier than 3 (three) years before the start date of Junior Residency, i.e., 24th August 2026, will be considered. Candidates whose compulsory rotating internship will be completed on or before 24.08.2026 are also eligible to apply and appear in the Written Exam and/or Interview, but must produce the original Internship Completion Certificate on the day of the exam/interview. Candidates who have already completed 2 terms of Junior Residency (Non-Academic), either at AIIMS or elsewhere, will not be considered. Experience in Army services, Central Health Services, Private Nursing Homes, and Private practice is treated as equivalent to Junior Residency (Non-Academic) for this purpose. Note: A term of JR (Non-Academic) is 6 months; if a candidate joins and leaves at any point, it is counted as one full term irrespective of the actual duration worked. A separate application is required for each term.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Kalyani Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for AIIMS Kalyani Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 consists of: Written Exam: Conducted after verification of the application and requisite documents of the candidates. Personal Interview: Final selection is based on the performance in the Personal Interview of candidates who qualify the Written Exam - the Written Exam itself is used only for shortlisting/qualifying, not for final merit. Candidates working in Government/Semi-Government/PSU organisations must submit a "No Objection Certificate" (NOC) from their employer; in-service candidates will not be permitted to appear for the interview without this NOC. All candidates completing their qualifying eligibility criteria by 24th August 2026 shall be eligible. The number of seats/posts is subject to increase or decrease at the discretion of the authorities, depending on requirement.

faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Kalyani Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification (Advt. No. 1650/E-12015/25/26-(SR/T/JR), dated 31.07.2026) released by AIIMS Kalyani for engagement of 84 Junior Resident (Non-Academic) posts on a 6-month tenure basis across various departments of the Institute.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Kalyani Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 84 vacancies are available: UR-34, EWS-8, OBC-23, SC-13, ST-6, with 3 posts reserved for PwBD candidates on a horizontal basis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Kalyani Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration is 24.08.2026, 5:00 PM. The Written Exam is tentatively scheduled for 08.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for AIIMS Kalyani Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MBBS degree from an NMC-recognised institution, with a completed compulsory internship and registration under any State Medical Council. MBBS (including internship) must have been completed not earlier than 3 years before 24th August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AIIMS Kalyani Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 33 years as on the last date of submission of the application, with age relaxation of 10 years for PwBD, 5 years for SC/ST, and 3 years for OBC candidates. No relaxation applies to SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against UR vacancies.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for AIIMS Kalyani Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1,000 for UR/OBC candidates and Rs. 500 for SC/ST/EWS candidates, payable via Demand Draft in favour of "AIIMS KALYANI INTERNAL RESOURCES ACCOUNT". PwBD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for AIIMS Kalyani Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can register online through the Google Form link (https://forms.gle/4f8GaA6iePAsazbC9) provided on the official AIIMS Kalyani website, uploading the required documents before the closing date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for AIIMS Kalyani Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a Written Exam followed by a Personal Interview of qualified candidates. Final selection is based solely on Personal Interview performance.
